units: SI; angles in config are degrees, state angles are radians

frame.h: geometric COM altitude above mean sea level
frame.wind: ground-relative horizontal air velocity; positive downrange

environment.shipLocation: free for each nominal scenario; fixed when testing a prepositioned ship
environment.earthRotation: omitted in v1; sensitivity validation deferred
environment.atmosphere: COESA1976 lower layers only; reject out-of-range trajectories

operations.nullRateMeaning: instantaneous actuator idealization, not zero rate
operations.coastActuators: no RCS or active fins; no commanded torque with engine off
operations.status: design assumptions; operational scheduling constraints must be enforced by P2, existing RHS enforces magnitude limits only

geometry.contact: COM height minus cylindrical vertical support extent equals deck height
geometry.inertia: uniform dry cylinder; propellant concentrated at COM, negligible pitch inertia

touchdown.positionStatus: P2 must enforce relative to selected ship; current free-location diagnostics do not enforce this

sensitivity.kind: deterministic scenario points, not confidence intervals

safety.nullMeaning: report diagnostic peaks; no sourced structural or thermal pass/fail threshold adopted; touchdown feasibility is not full safety certification
